      .apply(lambda x: np.sum(x['size'] * x['quantity']) / np.sum(x['quantity']))
      .reset_index(name='mean_size')
)

# c. Retain reefs with >=3 distinct survey years

valid = year_counts[year_counts >= 3].index
data = data[data['id_reef'].isin(valid)].reset_index(drop=True)

# Add continuous year and reef code for clustering
data['year_cont'] = data['year']
data['reef_code'] = data['id_reef'].astype('category').cat.codes
# Ensure protection_status is categorical
data['protection_status'] = data['protection_status'].astype('category')

# 2. Fixed-effects OLS with cluster-robust SE by reef
formula_fe = (
    'mean_size ~ year_cont * C(protection_status, Treatment(reference="sin proteccion")) '
    '+ C(id_reef) + C(year)'
)
model_fe = smf.ols(formula_fe, data=data)
res_fe = model_fe.fit(cov_type='cluster', cov_kwds={'groups': data['reef_code']})
print("Fixed-Effects OLS with Clustered SE by Reef:\n")
print(res_fe.summary())

# 3. Interaction coefficient for Cabo Pulmo vs unprotected

coef, se = res_fe.params.get(param_int), res_fe.bse.get(param_int)
print(f"\nInteraction (slope diff) for Cabo Pulmo vs unprotected: {coef:.4f} ± {se:.4f}\n")

# 4. Per-reef slope estimation and Tukey HSD

    m = sm.OLS(grp['mean_size'], sm.add_constant(grp['year_cont'])).fit()
    slopes.append({

    })

import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

# 1. Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Calculate weighted mean fish size per reef-year
agg = (
    df.groupby(['id_reef', 'year', 'protection_status'], dropna=False)
      .apply(lambda x: np.sum(x['size'] * x['quantity']) / np.sum(x['quantity']))
      .reset_index(name='mean_size')
)

# 3. Clean data
data = agg.dropna(subset=['protection_status']).reset_index(drop=True)

# 4. Compute annual slopes per reef
def slope(group):
    m = np.polyfit(group['year'], group['mean_size'], 1)
    return m[0]

reef_slopes = data.groupby(['id_reef', 'protection_status']).apply(slope).reset_index(name='slope')

# 5. Compare slopes by protection status: ANOVA and pairwise t-tests
anova = stats.f_oneway(*[group['slope'].values for _, group in reef_slopes.groupby('protection_status')])
pairwise = stats.pairwise_tukeyhsd(reef_slopes['slope'], reef_slopes['protection_status'])

print("ANOVA on Slopes by Protection Status:\n", anova)
print("\nPairwise Comparisons (Tukey HSD) on Slopes:\n", pairwise)

# 6. Summary of mean slopes
group_means = reef_slopes.groupby('protection_status')['slope'].agg(['mean', 'sem', 'count'])
print("\nMean Annual Slope by Protection Status:\n", group_means)

# 7. Plot distribution of slopes
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.boxplot(x='protection_status', y='slope', data=reef_slopes)
plt.title('Distribution of Annual Slope of Mean Fish Size by Protection Status')

plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()"}
